summary: Telecom Argentina S.A. filed a Form 6-K containing an English translation of a letter dated November 6, 2026 to the Argentine Securities Exchange Commission (Comisión Nacional de Valores), disclosing the resignation of Director Luca Luciani for personal reasons, effective as of the Shareholders Meeting that appoints his replacement. The Board will consider the resignation at its next meeting. No price, stake, premium, advisor, or transaction mechanics are stated. This is a routine foreign-private-issuer board vacancy disclosure, not a forced or abrupt CEO/CFO departure and not a special situation; no structural or regulatory-clock elements apply, and no risk-arb angle exists.
